name: Schedule Compression
excerpt: Schedule Compression involves techniques to shorten the project schedule.
notes: Schedule Compression includes techniques like crashing, which involves making cost and schedule trade-offs, and fast tracking, which involves doing activities in parallel that would normally be done in sequence. These techniques are used to meet project deadlines but can increase risk.
context_summary:
- Involves techniques to shorten the project schedule.
- Includes crashing and fast tracking.
- Can increase risk while meeting project deadlines.
